title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret — Episode1 To the Morinomiya Revue!

meta.Event Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Look at this theatre...!
It's like a castle straight out of a fairytale...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow... So this is the Morinomiya Revue...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This theatre's so pretty!!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I wasn't expecting it to be quite so extravagant! Not only that, the path between here and the station was designed in the same manner...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose we should expect nothing less from the Morinomiya Revue, since it's been around for over a hundred years.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. The all-female Suzurangumi is so popular that even people overseas talk about them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But recently, the all-male Kikyogumi has started to gain some traction as well. Getting to train here really is a huge honor...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed!
We'll need to thank Emu's brothers again later for winning us this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
You're standing as straight as an arrow, Nene! Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... But I am feeling pretty nervous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Morinomiya is like a dream stage for people who dream of becoming musical actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Very true.
Their grand and refined shows are captivating to not just the viewing public, but also actors all over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely! The pinnacle of musical excellence in Japan! Quite a few former Morinomiya members have gone on to become famous actors!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we can't leave out the part about their practices being really hard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they are famous for pushing their actors to the absolute limit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Which is why I think we need to be prepared mentally.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm not just feeling nervous right now. I mean...)

Excuse me.
You're Wonderlands×Showtime, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...!
Y-Yes, that's us!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line:
It's wonderful to finally meet you.
My name is Arita. I'm a member of the production team here at the Morinomiya Revue.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: I'll be your guide today, so I'll be happy to explain everything as needed. For now, I'm very much looking forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
We also look forward to working with you!!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: First, let me show you around our facilities. Please, come this way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I have to say, this place is astounding...!
The theatre is one thing, but this rehearsal room is enormous!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm also surprised by how much equipment this place has available. I suppose I shouldn't expect anything less from a highly successful enterprise.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna learn as much as I can about how they run things around here!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Hehe. Your brothers indicated that to us a little while back, so we went ahead and created a special position for you.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: During your time here, you'll mostly be involved in the operational side of things.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Anyway, this concludes my tour. From here, I'll be explaining more about how you'll be practicing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: But there's something I need to mention to all of you first.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: I regret to inform that you will not be practicing with any members of this revue during your time here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: We agreed to give you all this opportunity after seeing everything you've all done at Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Unfortunately, outside of publicity events, non-affiliated parties are not allowed to observe our rehearsals. This is a mandate from management.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: So, during this visit, you'll all be training with the Morinomiya Music Academy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?! We get to take lessons at the Morinomiya Music Academy?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, I've heard of that school!
It's where everyone studies to become members of the Morinomiya Revue, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's right.
Several hundred apply to enroll each year, but they're competing for around thirty spots.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Only those who are accepted can apply to become members of the Morinomiya Revue. In other words, they're the best of the best.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: Also, practices at the academy are also divided based on gender.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: So, Mr. Tenma, Mr. Kamishiro, you'll be participating in the all-boys practices.

rows.Speaker: Arita
rows.Line: And you in the all-girls practices, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm doing operations, Tsukasa and Rui are with the boys, and Nene's with the girls... Doesn't that mean we're all gonna be separated?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
This is a little different from what we're used to, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Understood...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I am a little worried about being separated from the others.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But getting to train at the Morinomiya Music Academy is a huge opportunity for us. I'm really looking forward to this experience...!
The next day
Morinomiya Music Academy
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, Ms. Kusanagi, this is the class you'll be working with starting today for the next three months.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Beyond this door are Morinomiya's students...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The chosen few who've gathered from all over Japan. Their acting and singing skills must surely be incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't have time to be scared.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because I'm also going to keep growing as an actress!!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Anyway, Ms. Kusanagi, shall we enter?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes!
